entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2 (World Cache) — hash-grid radiance caching for path-tracer secondary hits.
entries.notes: Cell-only port (no tile/mip chain, no separate indirect/multibounce buffers, no decay buffer). Flat hash table keyed on (quantize(posWS, AdaptiveCellSize), packOctahedral(N) at 3 bits/axis); open-addressing with probe length 4; eviction by frameLastTouched on collision. Two-buffer EMA topology (scratch + value, drained by GPUPathTracerHashGridFilter.comp) mirroring gi1.comp:2160-2217. Power-of-2 cell-size quantisation per hash_grid_cache.hlsl:96-102. Phase-1 writes/reads at the PT primary hit (D6/D7 — phase 2 closes the secondary-vertex gap). Divergences in .alignments/TASK-77.1.3-hash-grid-cache-paper-port.md.

entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2.3 — exponential moving average accumulation in the world cache.
entries.notes: Drains per-frame scratch contributions into the persistent value buffer. Mirrors UpdateTilesMain (gi1.comp:2160-2217) reduced to the flat-hash single-mip shape: one thread per hash slot, EMA blend with weight 1/min(value+scratch, MAX) — Capsaicin's single-sample weight choice that bounds per-frame change at 1/MAX once saturated.

entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2 (World Cache) — read-side composition of cached vs. fresh radiance. Phase-1 simplification of Capsaicin's multi-tap reuse: a single sampleCount-driven lerp.
entries.notes: TASK-77.1.2 — denoise composition rule lerp(noisy, cached, saturate(sampleCount/32)). Lookup site is screen-space primary hit (Capsaicin reads at secondary vertices inside the bounce loop); flat hash, no tile/mip cone-filter. Divergences flagged for paper-port audit at TASK-77.1.3 closure.

entries.paper: Troy Sobotka — AgX (display rendering transform). Sigmoid contrast curve in log-encoded display-referred space; replaces ACES Filmic tonemapping.
entries.reference: https://github.com/sobotka/AgX (canonical) + https://github.com/google/filament/blob/main/filament/src/ToneMapper.cpp (Filament's polynomial-fit port) + https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/src/renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/tonemapping_pars_fragment.glsl.js (Three.js port the engine implementation follows)
entries.notes: Polynomial-fit AgX-Default — single-pass, no LUT. Matrices and EV bounds are named constants in the file; sigmoid is the AgXDefaultContrastApprox polynomial.
